integrity: Analytic derivation and independently replayable finite numerical checks are supplied. No independent audit or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact integrated substeps and symmetric bases. The full-inertia result assumes a positive definite old-old block; the sharp rank-two cutoff is confined to the stated three-dimensional gradient flow. The tied-singular-value boundary is nonunique; global convergence and other integrators are not classified.
title: Indefinite rank growth and a sharp SVD sign transition in parallel low-rank integration
